name: KAHN SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-KHSK-34L Kahn Shaker is a heavy-duty horizontal reciprocating shaker engineered specifically for clinical and pathology laboratories. It is essential for providing smooth, powerful, and consistent back-and-forth agitation to mix samples in Kahn racks during critical serological and flocculation tests.
features: Smooth Horizontal Reciprocating motion for agitating and blending
Driven by a reliable imported DC motor reaching up to 250 RPM
Digital LED display of RPM on the control panel
Heavy duty metal angle supported powder-coated mild steel cabinet
Adjustable steel rods with rubber sleeves to secure various bottles and flasks

specifications.Cabinet Material: Powder coated MS with heavy-duty metal angles
specifications.Flask Holder: Adjustable Steel rods with rubber sleeve
specifications.Target Applications: Serological mixing, Flocculation tests, General sample blending
